text:
Zoe Park: Dropping a compact prototype for the latency card — focus is p95 axis labels, a lightweight sampling slider, and a small sampled ribbon. Figma: https://figma.com/file/latency-mini
Marco Li: Quick glance 1: love the ribbon placement. small nit: 'Sampled' could be confused with 'error' by some users. Maybe 'Partial data (10%)' instead.
Hannah Ortiz: Agreed on wording. Also the slider thumb needs a visible label when focused: show current percent above the thumb.
Devon Shaw: Implementation detail: the thumb label should be aria-hidden but also available as aria-live when changed for screen readers.
Zoe Park: Proposed aria snippet: role="slider" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="10" aria-label="Preview sampling percentage". Also the ribbon will have aria-live="polite".
a11y-bot: Scan: recommend adding aria-describedby on the ribbon pointing to an offscreen explanation: "This chart shows sampled data; results may differ from full data." Also ensure thumb label contrast >=4.5:1.
Marco Li: About the p95 axis: can we show both absolute ms and relative (delta) on hover? e.g., "420 ms ( +12% vs last 1h)". Keeps tooltip compact.
Hannah Ortiz: Love that. For color scale, prefer a single-hue sequential with increased luminance rather than multi-hue; simpler for colorblind and printing.
Devon Shaw: UX edge: when user increases sampling to 100% on big ranges, show a small cost estimation modal. Text: "Loading full data may take ~30s and increase compute. Continue?" with Confirm/Cancel.
Zoe Park: Good call. Final ask: keyboard order should put the slider after timepicker, and sampled ribbon must be reachable via Tab and have a focus ring. I'll update figma and add the aria snippets.
images-bot: Uploaded: designs/latency/p95-mini-slider-ribbon.png
Zoe Park: Thanks 1 will ping once updated for a11y pass.
